lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns and horizontal rows on the lateral surface posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Spots coincide with intersections of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity, though horizontal banding is partially obscured by interlacing artifacts.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition, with higher pixel values on the dorsal side of the ridge and lower values in the shadowed ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small, high-intensity blobs across its dorsal surface mask.
